rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses from a Board Registered CE Provider, ADA CERP or AGD PACE providers (individual courses are not approved by the Board); out-of-state courses by other providers only after Board approval
rules.new_licensee_rule: Dentists renewing for the first time are exempt from CE.
rules.audit_note: Random CE audits since 2009; keep course certificates for three renewal periods. Shortfall can lead to a citation and fine.
rules.alternatives: Retired dentists in uncompensated practice only: 30 units including the mandatory courses (16 CCR 1017(u)).

topics.who: California Infection Control course from a Board-approved mandatory course provider
California Dental Practice Act course from a Board-approved mandatory course provider
Responsibilities and Requirements of Prescribing Schedule II Opioids, from a Board-approved mandatory course provider
Live BLS with skills session (AHA, Red Cross, ASHI, CERP or PACE); max 4 units count

rules.notes: Max 50% non-live/correspondence (live webinars count as live); max 8 units per day. BLS (AHA, Red Cross, ASHI, CERP or PACE; live skills session, max 4 units) is mandatory. Permits need extra units: GA 24, moderate sedation 15, oral conscious sedation 7. License expires the last day of the birth month, even/odd year per birth year.
rules.legal_basis: Title 16, California Code of Regulations, Sections 1015, 1016 and 1017; Business and Professions Code § 1715
